title: Collision Warning and Collision Avoidance: Component Location
introduction:
This drawing locates the highlighted component at the top of the instrument panel near the base of the windshield. HUD means head up display.

I read the transparent vehicle view as a map pin for the dashboard: find the cyan highlight, follow its leader line to the enlarged inset, then match the inset callout to the Item and Description table. The inset helps you recognize the component’s shape, while the vehicle view supplies its position.

This is a location reference. It does not show a trim-removal route, connector details or a diagnostic test, and the transparent bodywork should not be mistaken for physical access.
